name: input_only_conditional_signed_utility_v1
selection: Minimum internal-dev utility MSE over fixed checkpoints. Calibrate intervention threshold on internal-dev CE including no-change option. Validation only after selection.
objective: Predict centered first-order expert cost from pre-expert input. Same labels, samples and rank for all architectures; exact finite replacement outcomes separately assessed.
continuation: Review utility R2 against constant expert means and internal-dev replacement effects across all three seeds. Do not choose a quantum winner from validation or promote static assignment from round1. A no-change calibrated policy is a valid negative result.
